DIAGNOSIS READY: Congenital Rubella Syndrome.

The history of maternal rubella infection combined with prematurity, respiratory distress requiring support, and the classic triad of apnea (respiratory) and anemia (cardiovascular) strongly suggests this diagnosis. I will now request the specific test results to confirm.
